description: Noetic-dev delivery governance state machine — states, transitions, and role authorities.

UNGOVERNED_EXISTING.description: Existing branches/PRs before governance was applied.

AUDIT_REQUIRED.description: Audit is needed before any transition.

AUDITED.description: Audit complete; ready for issue acceptance.

ISSUE_ACCEPTED.description: Issue is accepted for governed work.

PLAN_REQUESTED.description: A planning pass has been requested.

PLAN_READY.description: Planning pass complete and plan approved.

CANDIDATE_PINNED.description: Implementation candidate SHA pinned; ready for validation and QA.

QA_RUNNING.description: Adversarial QA running against pinned candidate.

REMEDIATING.description: Remediation generation in progress (new implementation pass).

INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_PENDING.description: Candidate ready for independent high-reasoning Fable or Sol review.

READY_TO_INTEGRATE_DEV.description: Feature candidate approved for squash integration into protected dev.

MERGED_TO_DEV.description: Feature candidate integrated into protected dev; post-integration validation pending.

POST_DEV_VALIDATING.description: Validation running against the exact protected dev integration SHA.

MAIN_PROMOTION_PENDING.description: Validated dev work is eligible to request, but does not yet have, owner authorization for promotion to main.

MAIN_PROMOTION_AUTHORIZED.description: The repository owner authorized a bounded promotion candidate from exact dev to main.

READY_TO_MERGE.description: The separately validated and reviewed promotion candidate is ready for the protected exact main ref-update operation.

MERGED_TO_MAIN.description: Protected main was atomically fast-forwarded to the exact candidate SHA; post-update validation is pending.

PUBLICATION_READY.description: Post-merge validation passed; ready to publish.

BLOCKED.description: State blocked until its named condition is resolved by an authorized agent role.

ROLLED_BACK.description: Published/deployed work rolled back; terminal state.

reviewer.description: Independent Fable or Sol agent using an authorized reviewer profile at high reasoning against an immutable snapshot.

orchestrator.description: Coordinates planning dispatch; read-only on implementation/QA.

planner.description: Read-only; produces plans. Cannot implement, QA, remediate, approve, or publish.

implementer.description: Modifies files in issue worktree; cannot QA or publish.

remediator.description: Modifies files for remediation; cannot QA or publish.

validator.description: Records command exit codes and produces validation results.

qa.description: Exactly one adversarial QA pass per implementation/remediation generation. Read-only source mount.

publisher.description: Deterministic execution only after all gates pass. Cannot substitute for independent reviewer approval.

owner.description: Human repository owner; exclusively authorizes exact-SHA promotion from protected dev to protected main.
